tools.name: simkl_get_trending_by_genre
tools.description: Get monthly trending titles for one genre from Simkl’s public CDN. Rankings are updated daily, contain up to 500 titles, and have no upstream pagination. The CDN request needs no user token and uses no Simkl daily quota or per-second rate. Supply an exact genre slug from the selected media type’s genre index; returns up to maxResults rich items without fetching details per title.

tools.name: simkl_search_by_text
tools.description: Search Simkl by title. Prefer tv for TV shows, anime for anime, or movie for movies whenever the media type is known or reliably inferred. Use all only when the correct type cannot be determined; it is not the default. One all request suffices instead of three separate searches. Mixed results carry their own endpoint_type. Do not search before scrobble or write operations when usable IDs are already available.

type.description: Prefer tv for TV, anime for anime, or movie for movies when known or inferred. Use all only as the unknown-type fallback; never as a convenience default.

q.description: Required. The search term — matches `title` and `all_titles[]` across the chosen catalog (movies / TV / anime).  Examples: `john wick`, `john wick 2014`, `breaking bad`, `cowboy bebop`.

extended.description: `full` adds overview, ratings, and genres to each match.

sort.description: Result order. `relevance` (default) puts the best match first; `release-date` newest first; `last-air-date` most recently aired first — **TV and anime only**: a `400` on `movie`, and accepted with `al

tools.name: simkl_get_shows_by_genre
tools.description: Live TV genre browsing supports other sorts and country, network, and year filters. Under AUTH V2 it requires the user access token and consumes the user’s daily allowance; live requests also count toward the per-second limit. Pagination is capped at page 20 and 60 items per page. Prefer simkl_get_trending_by_genre for this month’s most watched titles in one genre (daily-updated CDN file, no token or upstream quota).

genre.description: TV genre slug, or `all`. See description for the full set.

year.description: `all`, single year, or decade. Bogus values silently fall back to `all`.

tools.name: simkl_get_anime_by_genre
tools.description: Live anime genre browsing supports other sorts and network and year filters. Under AUTH V2 it requires the user access token and consumes the user’s daily allowance; live requests also count toward the per-second limit. Pagination is capped at page 20 and 60 items per page. Prefer simkl_get_trending_by_genre for this month’s most watched titles in one genre (daily-updated CDN file, no token or upstream quota).

genre.description: Anime genre slug, or `all`. See description for the full set.

tools.name: simkl_get_movies_by_genre
tools.description: Live movie genre browsing supports other sorts and country and year filters. Under AUTH V2 it requires the user access token and consumes the user’s daily allowance; live requests also count toward the per-second limit. Pagination is capped at page 20 and 60 items per page. Prefer simkl_get_trending_by_genre for this month’s most watched titles in one genre (daily-updated CDN file, no token or upstream quota).

genre.description: Movie genre slug, or `all`. See description for the full set.

type.description: Reserved — always pass the literal value `movies`.

year.description: `all`, single year (`2019`), or decade (`2010s`, `2000s`). Bogus values silently fall back to `all`.

tools.name: simkl_get_user_stats
tools.description: Get watch statistics for another explicitly identified Simkl user. For your own authenticated account, use simkl_my_stats instead: it reads the per-account cache without a settings lookup.

user_id.description: Numeric Simkl ID of another explicitly identified user. For your own account, use simkl_my_stats with no arguments; do not fetch /users/settings.

tools.name: simkl_get_watchlist
tools.description: Search the authenticated user’s cached watchlist. Filters by media type, status, and title, then returns compact matching items with progress, next episode, rating, and a Simkl link.

offset.description: Zero-based number of matching results to skip; defaults to 0.

tools.name: simkl_start_rewatch
tools.description: Explicitly start or resume a Simkl rewatch session for a movie, TV show or anime already in the user history. Requires PRO/VIP. Simkl applies a two-day gap between repeat watches. The response includes the upstream rewatch_id and status; retain the ID for later updates.

tools.name: simkl_update_rewatch
tools.description: Add viewing events to a specific rewatch session. Always supply the rewatch_id returned by Simkl. TV/anime completion is determined by Simkl when all aired regular episodes are covered.

tools.name: simkl_delete_rewatch
tools.description: Delete one explicitly identified rewatch session without changing the original watch or library entry. Requires PRO/VIP and the session rewatch_id. Supply seasons with episode numbers to remove only those rewatched episodes; omit seasons to delete the whole session.

tools.name: simkl_get_rewatches
tools.description: Read compact rewatch sessions from the per-user activities-gated cache, separate from the canonical watchlist. No incremental sync parameters are accepted.

tools.name: simkl_stop_watching
tools.description: Stop watching and return the Simkl scrobble response. A 409 already_watched conflict is an already_recorded success with the original watched_at: do not retry. Set allow_rewatch=true only when the user explicitly chose to record this playback as a rewatch; it requires PRO/VIP and progress of at least 80%.

allow_rewatch.description: Explicitly record this stop as a rewatch. Defaults to false.

tools.name: simkl_get_user_custom_lists
tools.description: List a user’s custom lists with pagination. Omit user_id for your own account (includes private/unlisted lists and pinned flags). Simkl Custom Lists are a beta PRO/VIP feature and need the user’s AUTH V2 token. Call only on explicit user request: every call spends the user’s shared daily allowance, so never poll or re-read lists on a schedule.

user_id.description: Numeric Simkl user ID. Omit for the authenticated account.

collaborants.description: Include lists the user collaborates on (own account only).

tools.name: simkl_get_custom_list
tools.description: Get one custom list’s details and a page of its titles. A free account receives an upgrade placeholder, reported as an error rather than list data. Simkl Custom Lists are a beta PRO/VIP feature and need the user’s AUTH V2 token. Call only on explicit user request: every call spends the user’s shared daily allowance, so never poll or re-read lists on a schedule.

sort.description: Free-form order token; unknown tokens silently fall back. Omit to use the owner’s order.

extended.description: Add an overview to every item.

tools.name: simkl_create_custom_list
tools.description: Create a custom list. name and media_type are required; media_type cannot change later. New lists are public unless privacy is set. Plan limits: 30 lists on PRO, 1,000 on VIP. Simkl Custom Lists are a beta PRO/VIP feature and need the user’s AUTH V2 token. Requires the media:write scope. Writes for one account run one at a time; an ambiguous failure is never replayed automatically.

description.description: Send either key alone; the other is kept. "" clears one.

note.description: Owner’s private note on the whole list. "" clears it.

sort.description: The list’s own default order. Refused on auto lists.

by.description: Order token, e.g. position (manual order), rating, title, added.

tags.description: REPLACES the whole public tag set; [] removes all tags.

private_tags.description: REPLACES the whole private tag set; [] removes all.

collaborators.description: REPLACES the whole collaborator set: anyone omitted is removed, [] removes everyone. Adding someone new needs VIP.

user.description: Simkl user ID the caller follows.

tools.name: simkl_update_custom_list
tools.description: Edit a custom list’s details. Send only fields that change; omitted fields are kept. tags, private_tags and collaborators each REPLACE the whole set: read the list first and send the complete desired set. media_type cannot change; titles are edited with simkl_add_custom_list_items. Simkl Custom Lists are a beta PRO/VIP feature and need the user’s AUTH V2 token. Requires the media:write scope. Writes for one account run one at a time; an ambiguous failure is never replayed automatically.

tools.name: simkl_delete_custom_list
tools.description: Permanently delete a custom list with its titles, likes, follows and comments. There is no undo. Owner or a collaborator with full permission only. Simkl Custom Lists are a beta PRO/VIP feature and need the user’s AUTH V2 token. Requires the media:write scope. Writes for one account run one at a time; an ambiguous failure is never replayed automatically.

tools.name: simkl_add_custom_list_items
tools.description: Add titles to a custom list, move them with user_position, or set their notes, in one request (up to 1000 titles). New titles go to the end in posted order; titles already on the list keep their place unless user_position or allow_reorder is used. Titles of the wrong media type come back in wrong_type. Simkl Custom Lists are a beta PRO/VIP feature and need the user’s AUTH V2 token. Requires the media:write scope. Writes for one account run one at a time; an ambiguous failure is never replayed automatically.

allow_reorder.description: Let the posted order move titles already on the list. Without it, existing titles stay put and only user_position moves a title.
